briefing: Markets drifted lower today with NASDAQ -0.3% and S&P 500 -0.4% — a neutral, low-conviction session. Cash sits at $489.29, just under the $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy; existing 7 positions stay untouched and risk rules will auto-manage stops and targets.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today's cash balance was just below the $500 threshold and the market showed no clear risk-on signal, so the disciplined move was to hold that cash rather than force a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指保留在場邊、等待良機出手的現金。今日現金餘額略低於500美元門檻，且市場未出現明確的風險偏好訊號，因此紀律性的做法是保留現金觀望，而非勉強進場交易。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices slipped modestly today, with NASDAQ down 0.3% and the S&P 500 down 0.4%, reflecting a broadly cautious, directionless tone rather than any single dominant catalyst. Without a strong risk-on or risk-off signal, institutional flows appear mixed, keeping volatility contained. This kind of quiet pullback is common and doesn't necessarily signal a shift in trend.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤小幅走弱，納斯達克指數下跌0.3%，標普500指數下跌0.4%，反映市場氣氛審慎、缺乏明確方向，並非受單一重大消息主導。在沒有明顯風險偏好或避險訊號的情況下，資金流向較為分散，市場波動維持在有限範圍內。這類溫和回調屬常見現象，未必代表趨勢轉變。
